name: Granite Thought
description: Wear a mantle of thought grown dense as stone so that no push of will can shift it.

name: Regrown Layer
description: Regrow a battered layer of the ward from the sound one beneath until none is missing.

name: Vacant Step
description: Step the soul out of the line of a blow and back into the ward within the same breath.

name: Mirror Depth
description: Send an assault into the depth of the ward and return it from a point no one can predict.

name: Iron Quiet
description: Hold a silence so absolute that every hostile will within it falls quiet.

name: Wound Refusal
description: Refuse the lingering damage of a soul wound until it unmakes itself in an ally.

name: Vast Cover
description: Spread the ward over an entire host so that each mind in it stands as firm as the user.

name: Whole Hunger
description: Open the ward to drink a siege of hostile force down to its last thread.

name: Standing Sovereign
description: The school's pillar in which the user stands as a ward for all and mends them in a measure set by the user's reserve.

name: Judging Silence
description: The school's last verdict that stills a field of wills in a weight set by the user's reserve.

name: Immutable Ward
description: Make the ward unchanging so that an assault of wills is undone and returned at the destructive ceiling of its tier.

name: Never Entered
description: The soul becomes a place no will has entered and no energy mechanic explains why every intrusion has failed; use is a consequence event.
